title: Custom Quiz Builder (Wayfinding)
prompt:
Mobile screen, iPhone 393x852, dark OLED. App "NY RE Exam": a one-person study app for the New York State real estate salesperson exam, used on the subway. Design system "Wayfinding": New York transit signage language, not nostalgia. Canvas #090d16, surface cards #111725, raised controls #182033, 1px hairlines rgba(148,163,184,.16) only where they group things, primary text #f1f5f9, secondary text #a3b1c6, go green #10b981 for the primary action and selected states, caution amber #f59e0b for bookmarks. Headings in Helvetica Neue bold, sentence case, tight tracking -0.02em; UI text in SF Pro, 17px body, 15px secondary, 13px meta, tabular numbers. Radii: 24 sheets, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. 16px screen gutters, 20px between sections. Never use all-caps labels, middle-dot separators, or arrows on buttons. Elevation through surface lightness, not shadows.

Screen: the custom quiz builder, designed like planning a subway trip: pick your lines (topics), the trip length (question count), how you ride (mode), then go.

Top: compact large-title header "Custom quiz" (28px Helvetica Neue bold) with a secondary line "286 questions match" under it. No back arrow, no logo, no tab bar anywhere on this screen.

Section "Topics": heading with "12 of 19" in secondary text, and on the right two quiet text buttons "All" and "None". Below it a strip-map list on one surface card: 19 topic rows grouped into 7 subway lines. Each row is a 44px station: a 26px circular route bullet (bold single character, line color) + the topic name + a small question count right-aligned + a check mark when selected. Within each group a 4px vertical line in the group's color runs through the centers of the bullets, connecting them like stations on a strip map; 12px gap between groups. Unselected rows: the bullet becomes a hollow ring in the line color, the name drops to secondary color, no check. Groups and topics:
- red #DA291C, white text: 1 License Law & Article 12-A, 2 Law of Agency, 3 Human Rights & Fair Housing
- green #00843D, white text: 4 Real Estate Finance, 5 Valuation & Market Analysis, 6 Real Estate Math
- blue #0039A6, white text: A Legal Issues & Land Title, C Estates & Encumbrances, E Real Estate Contracts
- orange #FF6319, dark text: B Land Use Regulations, D Municipal Agencies, F Construction & Environment, M Property Insurance
- yellow #FCCC0A, dark text: N Taxes & Assessments, Q Closing & Settlement, R Commercial Real Estate, W Property Management
- purple #9B2A92, white text: 7 Condos & Co-ops
- lime #6CBE45, dark text: G Rentals & Deal Sheets
Show most rows selected and a few unselected (Real Estate Math, the whole yellow line, Condos & Co-ops).

Section "Questions": an iOS segmented control on #182033 with 10, 25, 50, 75 (75 selected with a lighter raised thumb), and beside it a compact 72px number field captioned "Custom".

Section "Mode": two large side-by-side selectable cards (18px radius, about 128px tall). Left "Tutor": book icon, "Instant feedback with the legal citation after every answer". Right "Timed exam": clock icon, "Answers hidden until you submit, 90:00 on the clock". The selected card (Timed exam) has a 2px go-green ring and a small filled go-green check in its corner; the other card is plain surface.

Section "Question pool": a four-segment control where each segment shows its label with the count on a second line: All 286, Unseen 214, Bookmarked 6, Mistakes 14 (All selected).

Then a grouped list card with two iOS switches (go green when on): "Shuffle question order" (on) and "Shuffle answer positions (A–D)" (on), separated by a hairline.

Bottom: sticky thumb-zone action bar on a translucent blurred canvas with a hairline top edge: a raised pill on the left showing a clock icon and "90:00" in tabular Helvetica Neue bold, and filling the rest one 56px go-green button "Start 75-question exam" with dark text, 14px radius.
